resources.string: SafeMobile calculates file hashes on this device and compares them with local definitions. Scan files and hashes are not uploaded. The offline build has no INTERNET permission and includes no ad, analytics, telemetry, or crash-reporting SDK. A separate feed build adds Internet access for a future opt-in HTTPS feed feature; do not use it until its explicit consent gate is in place. Installed-app visibility and all-files access are sensitive Android permissions and may require Google Play review.
Checks readable installed APKs against locally stored definitions and reviews files you select. Detection is limited by operating-system access and the definitions installed on this device.
Scan a selected APK or file
Optional monitoring of the public Downloads folder. Android 11+ requires the user to grant all-files access in Settings; Google Play approval is not guaranteed.
Monitoring is opt-in and can be stopped by the user.

Core scanning stays on this device. When connected, you can optionally support independent app development with a coffee contribution.
Offline definitions currently contain only the EICAR antivirus test signature; this does not protect against real-world malware. Import a curated, licensed local signature database.

SafeMobile validates the JSON structure and hash format, but this local file is not cryptographically authenticated by SafeMobile. Untrusted definitions may create false positives. Import only from a source you trust and are permitted to use. The file and hashes are not uploaded.
The support page could not be opened. Check your connection or try again later.
Review isolated private copies here. Restoring writes a copy to a destination you choose and keeps the quarantined original until you delete it.
Showing the 30 most recent quarantined files.
Restoring writes the file to a location you select. The restored file may be dangerous. Continue only if you trust the file or need it for controlled analysis. The quarantined copy will remain here.

Combines SMS permissions with network access; this is a risk indicator, not proof of malicious behavior.
Combines SMS permissions with an accessibility service declaration; this is a review signal, not proof of OTP interception or malware.
Limited protection — EICAR test definition only

Optional best-effort review of apps that declare overlay capability and accessibility services. Declarations and enabled accessibility services are only risk indicators; SafeMobile cannot prove that another app is currently displaying an overlay or inspect the current overlay-permission status of another app.
Apps declaring overlay capability: %1$d · Apps declaring accessibility services: %2$d · Enabled accessibility services on this device: %3$d
The last review attempt failed. Android may have deferred the job or denied the required package visibility.
Android did not permit this review. Check installed-app visibility and retry.
Notifications are disabled. The review can still run, but reminders will not be shown.
Low-priority reminders for the optional overlay-risk review.
%1$d apps declare overlay capability and %2$d declare accessibility services. These are review indicators, not proof of malware.
Feature availability depends on Android permissions and the current local definitions. These features do not provide guaranteed or complete malware protection.
Core file hashing and local signature matching run on-device. Ads and Google Play update checks are separate network-capable features when configured and permitted.
The scanner does not upload file contents or hashes. Advertising and Google Play services may make separate network requests.
Select and assess APKs or documents you choose. SafeMobile does not automatically inspect every WhatsApp message or attachment.
Local URL heuristics are available. No URLhaus threat feed or device-wide browser interception is configured in this build.
Choose a folder with the Android picker and review APK metadata before deleting selected items.
Installation-source metadata and remote-access app presence are review indicators, not proof of malware. Android does not allow a normal app to block every external install or force-stop other apps.
SafeMobile can report the readable state and open Android Settings. You must change protected global switches yourself.

Shows apps whose installer is not identified as Google Play, plus apps whose label/package resembles a remote-access product. Results depend on Android package visibility and available metadata.

This checker is not a global browser blocker. It does not follow redirects, inspect page content, intercept links inside other apps, or verify the live reputation of a website. Shortened links are marked for review, not automatically called malicious.

Choose a folder with the Android Storage Access Framework. SafeMobile checks APK metadata only and never deletes files without your explicit confirmation. Access to Android/media or other folders varies by device.

Bulk deletion is limited to parseable APKs with no installed package match that are at least 30 days old. This is a cleanup heuristic, not proof that a file is unwanted.

Allow access to scan readable files in shared storage for known local signatures. Android still restricts access to some system and app-private locations; this does not inspect every file on the device.

SafeMobile checks readable installed APK files and app permission metadata. Package visibility is declared in the manifest; this step does not display a runtime permission dialog. Google Play policy approval is separate.
Notifications can show scan reminders and protection-service status. You can continue without them, but alerts may be limited by Android notification settings.

Download Sentinel is optional. When enabled, its foreground service watches APK file changes directly inside the accessible top-level Downloads folder. It cannot intercept every installation or monitor every app-specific folder.
Best-effort APK file monitoring in Downloads. Android controls installation and can stop background work.
Checks installed APKs and readable shared-storage files against the local definitions available on this device. Results do not certify the device as malware-free.
Shared-storage access is unavailable. The scan can inspect installed APKs only; file coverage is limited until access is granted.
Local-only view of saved scan audit records and current protection state. Counts reflect the records available here, not a malware-free guarantee.
Seven-day view of the latest 50 local audit entries returned by the database.
Run a scan to populate local history. An empty history is not a clean scan result.
Online; core hash checks remain local
Offline; core hash checks remain local

Dataset limitation: bundled offline definitions contain only the harmless EICAR test-marker hash. This is not a real-world malware corpus. User-imported definitions are schema-validated but not publisher-authenticated.
Installed app inventory is not available yet
Run an installed-app scan to populate this list. System and protected packages are review-only.
%1$d apps assessed in the latest available results

The current watcher observes APK create, move, and write-close events directly under the public Downloads directory while its foreground service is running. Events can be missed if the service stops or files are stored elsewhere. Post-install checks are best-effort and do not block Android installation.
Requests Accessibility plus overlay capability (potential overlay/RAT pattern)
Combines boot persistence, READ_SMS, and INTERNET (possible SMS/2FA theft pattern)
Recent package-install events with Android-reported installer metadata. External or unknown does not prove malware; review the local scan results.
After the privacy disclosure is accepted, package-install events are recorded locally when Android delivers them.
%1$s was installed; Android reports source: %2$s. Review before deciding what to do.
Standard Mode — Device Owner is not active
Device Owner is optional for personal use. A fully managed device enables stronger installation restrictions and administrator-controlled response to confirmed local hash matches.
Automatic response to confirmed malware hash matches

When enabled on a Device Owner device, exact local hash/IOC matches above the threshold may be hidden and an uninstall request queued. Permission heuristics and DEX strings alone never trigger removal.

Standard Mode works without Device Owner privileges. For production, use Android Enterprise QR-code provisioning during device setup. For testing only on a disposable device after factory reset and before completing setup, an administrator may run: adb shell dpm set-device-owner com.vibesync.antivirus/.core.security.AdminReceiver. This cannot be enabled by an in-app button on an already provisioned personal device. Device Owner mode can restrict installation and remove apps, so use it only on devices your organization manages.

Enabling automatic response permits Device Owner-only hiding and silent uninstall requests for non-system apps that have an exact local hash/IOC malware match and a risk score above 0.8. Android callback failures are not treated as successes.
